sources.title: PROTON
sources.snippet: PROTON is a graph AI model for neurological disease. (a)We demonstrate diverse disease-specific applications of PROTON using experimental and clinical data in three neurological conditions: Parkinson's disease (PD), bipolar disorder (BD), and Alzheimer's disease (AD).

sources.title: PROTON: A Relational Foundation Model for Neurological Discovery
sources.snippet: Foundation models have transformed AI by scaling sequence-based learning, but many scientific problems are not naturally sequential. In neuroscience, insight depends on relationships across genes, cell types, and brain systems.
